anchors.text: La construcción empieza por las dos hojas aritméticas de APP.
TRIT añade el régimen local y la orientación.
Topological Phase Kernel compone selección, transporte y actualización:

Las cinco
construcciones del continuo emergen conjuntamente
El problema concreto consiste en describir lo que conserva una realización

target.statement: Academic cumulative manuscript: reversible nonadic memory reconstructs K; positive network and rank-one amplituhedron preserve oriented residues under fixed-domain subdivision; energy has Schur reduction, reconstructible details and H1 limit; marked lattice deformation has reciprocal dual and theta inversion.
target.domain: Continuo conjunto heredado sobre H=Z_HMT×Omega_Gamma_cal y sus refinamientos compatibles
target.codomain: Positive memory cone; rank-two positive Grassmannian slice and stated rank-one amplituhedra; interval energy operators and H1 reader; marked covolume-one lattices and split signature (24,24)
target.closure_criterion: Memory inversion; positive ordered minors and oriented residue cancellation; fixed-domain subdivision; Schur reduction with retained detail and bounded-energy H1 limit; stated marked-lattice construction and reciprocal duality. Each conclusion retains the hypotheses of its public theorem.
target.causal_cutoff_reason: Las realizaciones grassmanniana y amplituhedral son lectores posteriores del estado enriquecido y del refinamiento conjunto del continuo; no seleccionan APP, TRIT ni TPK.

action_on_generators.effect: Conserva las dos hojas, residuos y cocientes.
Las incidencias APP de igual fase producen el acarreo balanceado.
Compone nueve aristas, retorna fase, avanza memoria y conserva el registro ordenado.
Seis vueltas forman cada bloque de 54 aristas; los truncamientos recuperan la historia completa.

proof_layers.finite: Hadamard reconstruction, planar path enumeration, Ptolemy, simplex barycentric inverses, rational form identities, exact Q(sqrt(5)) shape derivative.
proof_layers.compatibility: Inherited endpoints preserve minors and flips; fixed-domain subdivisions preserve canonical form; inherited directions preserve the partition function.

limit.finite_levels: All finite fixed-domain subdivisions with stored carry digits
limit.bonding_maps: Sum child weights and forget refinement only in the geometric reader
limit.limit_object: Compatible family of fixed-domain forms and inherited-direction potentials
limit.proof: Exact algebra at arbitrary finite depth; countable inherited-direction sums are grouped by twelve parents. No exchange of limits on changing domains is asserted.

proof_layers.recognition: Positive Grassmannian, rank-one amplituhedron and convex duality are downstream mathematical realizations.

residual_if_any: Higher grassmannian rank, survival-selected coverage and physical identification of the gap flow retain their separate obligations. The proved rank-one construction is complete on its stated domain.
global_falsifier: Negative ordered minor, uncovered polygon point, nonzero interior residue, changed partition function under inherited-direction subdivision; promotion of this realization to every TPK survival subdomain or rank k>1 without the corresponding proof.
